Author: Chittaranjan Dash

 Mr. Pullin Martha, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Mr. Shashanka Patra, A.S.C.

 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 21.02.2023
01. 1.

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioners and the State.

2. By means of this application, the Petitioners seek grant of bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. in apprehension of arrest for their alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 341/294/447/323/325/307/506/34, I.P.C.
in connection with Bolagarh P.S. Case No.39 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.143 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C. (Cog.), Khurda.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that the incident took place pursuant to a dispute regarding landed property and that the injuries are not grievous in nature.

However, learned counsel appearing for the Informant submits that the injuries are grievous in nature and Petitioner No.1 Gayadhar Nayak is having one criminal antecedent involving offence under Section 420, I.P.C.
4.

Keeping in view such submissions of the learned counsels for the parties, nature of the allegations, the circumstances appearing in the // 2 // case, the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that, in the event the Petitioners surrender and move for bail before the learned J.M.F.C.,(Cog.),Khordha in the aforesaid G.R. Case No.143 of 2023 within a period of three weeks from today, both of them shall be admitted to bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the said court, but subject to verification of criminal antecedents of the Petitioners and the injuries if not grievous.

1 5.

If it is found that there is more than one criminal antecedent to the credit of the Petitioners besides the present case and the injuries are found to be grievous, this order shall not be given effect to.

However, if the learned Magistrate is satisfied that there is only one criminal antecedent standing to the credit of the present Petitioners besides the present issue and the injuries are not grievous and admits the Petitioners to bail, the following further conditions be imposed - (i) The Petitioners shall appear before the I.O. and shall cooperate with the investigation as and when required by the I.O.
(ii) They shall also appear before the trial court on each date of posting of the case unless specifically exempted from such appearance by the court in seisin over the matter.
(iii) They shall not threaten, terrorise, intimidate or harass the informant party members as well as the prosecution witnesses in any manner and shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever, while on bail.

// 3 //
(iv) Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail of the Petitioners.
6. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
( Chittaranjan Dash ) Judge S.K. Parida Gayadhar Nayak & Another vs State Of Odisha ....
